requirements.text: A BLQ model contains elements. Each element has a location and comments
A BQL model has entries. Each entry has a name and a boolean attribute allFields
A BQL model has fields. Each field has a name
A BQL model contains queries and entries. Each query is composed of zero or more entries
A BQL model has entries and fields. Each field is composed by one or more fields
A BQL model has fields and entries. Each field is associated to exactly one entry
A BQL model has predicates and entries. Each Predicate is associated to exactly one entry
